def test_report_empty_stock():
    # Preconditions: a Stock with no items.
    # Postconditions: header, a "(no items)" marker, then the zero total.
    out = render_report(Stock()).splitlines()
    assert out[0].startswith("sku")
    assert out[1] == "(no items)"
    assert out[2].startswith("total")
    assert out[2].endswith("0.00")
    assert len(out) == 3
